## Plan / test matrix

Docs-only sweep (catalogue precedent: REC.1/REC.2/R2.22–24 — no cargo
suite required for a zero-code diff; `cargo fmt --all --check` +
`check-backlog.sh` + `check-build-memory.sh` + `^||` grep are the
mechanical gates). Grading rule used (stated in the appended summary):
`confirmed` only where every pending conditional clause of (d) is an
in-build deliverable/answer that demonstrably landed (artifact cited);
`still-valid-interim` where any conditional leg is external-standing or
owed; `fired-unanswered` where landed state contradicts a recorded
assumption with no answering artifact (→ CF row); `superseded-by-*`
where a superseding ADR retired the decision (none found — consistent
with the 2026-10-06 revisit-trigger sweep's 0-superseded tally).
